contact.heading: Visit Weathers Motors Today
contact.sub: As a family-owned and operated used car dealer here in Media, Weathers Motors has been a trusted Delaware County dealership for over a century now. We're proud to call Delco our home, but we've happily served drivers from West Chester to Allentown, PA and all points in between over our many years in business. Whether you're looking for a dependable ride for your daily commute, competitive rates on car loans, or just certified auto service at a fair price close to home, you can always rely on our team here at Weathers Motors.
